text: Steenbarger: nothing on the slate answers it. h1_close_above:bar_high has no volume clause; minervini's WAIT on 1.4x volume and wyckoff's volume bar are theirs to settle. My C23 backs the concern: a fresh extreme on contracting volume warns of a pause; day_vol 0.88 is off my menu. Volume alone does not clear me: elder_5d [5, 10, 10, 10, 10] is a summer plateau four bars past the transition (C20, C4), close_vs_swing_high_pct 6.96 is in front of value (C10). ACT_NOW should not stand on my read. I hold ABSTAIN; a fresh dip-and-reclaim nearer ma_20, entry on the reclaim, clears me.
